## Checklist

- [ ] Focused on one thing, branched from `main`.
- [ ] Tests added or updated for any behavior change.
- [ ] Any changed figure re-derives from public data, and the command is above.
- [ ] No claim is graded above what its tier supports.
- [ ] No identity claim, and no off-chain source used to upgrade an on-chain grade.
- [ ] Tooling stays stdlib-only except plotting, or the PR gives a reason.
